dataset.limitations: AI-authored proposed labels, not human reviewed. Near-duplicate detection cannot prove semantic independence. Candidate test set is developmental; original regression remains separate.

threshold_from_validation_only.policy: Maximum correct executable labels with zero observed validation label errors; exploratory, not calibrated.

candidate_confidence.warning: Exploratory calibration metrics on synthetic candidate examples; do not use as production confidence.

limitations: All expansion examples are generated synthetic proposals, not reviewer-accepted labels or a blind study. The fixed test set is developmental; later edits require a new version/split before reuse. Classifier labels never run queries. Database values, role/barangay authorization, official filters and API values are verified separately by deterministic Django tests.
